answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 46442 Country: India Title: protecting from sins Question: I am studying in college. I have some friends but those are all Hindus. Sometimes all friends decide to go to trip and there they go to mandir. They tell me to come into mandir. Should I have to go into their mandir just for seeing inside of mandir and nothing else? I believe in Allah. What should I have to do in that situation? Answer ID: 46442 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1130/876/B=1434) A Muslim should avoid visiting the centre of kufr and shirk. You should stay outside and accompany them when they come out. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
